title: APsystems EZ1 Devices Configuration
description: JSON schema for APsystems EZ1 inverter configuration used by apsystems_ez1_mqtt.py.

items.title: APsystems EZ1 Inverter
items.description: Configuration for one APsystems EZ1 inverter.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Unique identifier for the APsystems inverter used in MQTT topics and home assistant device IDs.

name.title: Display name
name.description: Display name for the APsystems device in Home Assistant.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the APsystems EZ1 inverter.

port.title: API port
port.description: TCP port for the local EZ1 REST API. Defaults to 8050.
